notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]1.1.0[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Added Golden Squimbus[/h3]
[*]1/100 chance to spawn instead of a regular squimbus (1/10 in credits)
[*]Has no other differences from regular squimbus other than appearance
[*][h3]Various Squimbus locations added[/h3]
[*]+5 in the hot biome  (Total of 6)
[*]+1 in the cold biome (Total of 3)
[*][h3]Warning added when creating a new save[/h3]
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Various small fixes and additions across all 3 biomes (including patching up The Hole)[/h3]
[*][h3]Squimbus spawn locations & navigation radii adjusted to not overlap with walls or worldweeds[/h3]
[*][h3]Bounceshroom & Melmee comics now appear as intended[/h3]
[*][h3]Links between solar systems in the Chapter 9 Constellation now display properly[/h3]
[*][h3]Fire Gas Planets now display properly in the to-do list[/h3]
[*][h3]Fixed various almanac entries not unlocking properly[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Released!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
Planetary Planter is now out on Steam! So what are you waiting for give it a download and play today! The team is also currently in talks about creating a mac version.
